text:
Samira (Design): Quick design sync for the batch rerank preview. New items: tiny heatmap mini-map, export filename convention, high-contrast switch for colors, and a short sr-friendly summary after rerank completes. Figma: https://figma.com/file/preview-rerank :mag:

Eli (Frontend): Mini-map idea is neatshows an overview of score distribution and lets users drag viewport. Implementation wise, it's a lightweight svg canvas. For a11y we need keyboard focus on the mini-map handles.

June (A11y): Keyboard focusable handles sound good. Also provide text alternative: "Distribution: 12 high, 30 medium, 58 low" announced on load. Make mini-map role=slider if it's interactive and label it properly.

Rohit (Product): Export filename: propose default pattern `projectname_queryset_YYYYMMDD_rerank.csv`. Users can edit before download. Also allow suffix `_with_context` when context included.

Parker (Data): Backend will accept a filename param. We'll also add a `meta` JSON blob header line like `# meta: {"model":"text-embed-v1","exported_at":"..."}` but note some parsers ignore comment JSON. It's useful for auditors.

Samira (Design): Copy options for primary CTA: "Re-rank results" vs "Apply ranking" vs "Rank by relevance". Which reads clearest?

Rohit (Product): "Re-rank results" is actionable and matches internal docs. Use that.

Eli (Frontend): Accessibility switch: add a compact "High contrast" toggle in view options which switches heatmap to high-sat colors + optional stripe pattern. Default = off. We'll persist per-user.

June (A11y): Please ensure the high-contrast mode also increases text size for legend and adds aria-live updates when user toggles it: "High contrast enabled". For screen readers after rerank, announce a brief summary: "Re-rank complete. 15 improved, 83 unchanged, 2 worsened." We'll compute delta server-side and return a short summary string in the response.

Parker (Data): We can add summary fields: improved_count, unchanged_count, worsened_count and a short `sr_summary` string. Front-end should surface `sr_summary` in an aria-live polite region and show a small toast with counts.

Samira (Design): Export modal copy: header "Export results"; primary action "Download CSV"; secondary link "Copy results to clipboard". Also include format radios: CSV, TSV and a checkbox "Include scores and rank" (default checked). If context included, show warning: "Including source text may expose sensitive data."

June (A11y): When enabling context export, show an aria-live alert: "Context export enabled. This includes full source text." Also the warning must be readable by screen reader and visually prominent.

Eli (Frontend): Keyboard flow: toolbar should be a single tab stop and arrow keys cycle actions. Pressing Enter on Re-rank opens options menu (model selection). Add Shift+R shortcut to trigger rerank only when table has focus; it's opt-out in preferences.

Rohit (Product): Agree on Shift+R opt-out. Also document default filename and allow users to set a custom template in project settings.

Parker (Data): CSV header suggestion: id,query,match,similarity_score,relevance_rank,model_version. We'll add a leading comment line with machine meta if allowed.

Samira (Design): Action items: Eli prototype mini-map + high-contrast toggle and toolbar ARIA; June to draft exact aria strings and aria-live snippets; Parker to add summary fields and filename param; Rohit to update product copy for export modal and filename template; Samira to update Figma and close loop next Tue.

ci-bot: Created ticket INF-5233 "rerank-export-filename-and-a11y-summary" and linked to thread.

Samira (Design): Thanks all 8522. Drop quick notes into Figma if you tweak copy.
